mcqs.question: Which group of Andhra Pradesh State Road Transport Corporation bus services is covered under the Divyang Shakti Scheme for free travel?
options: City Ordinary, Metro Express, Palle Velugu, Ultra Palle Velugu and Express
City Ordinary, Metro Express, Vajra, Ultra Palle Velugu and Express
Palle Velugu, Express, Rapid Response, Metro Express and City Ordinary
City Ordinary, Green Steel, Palle Velugu, Ultra Palle Velugu and Express
mcqs.explanation: The Divyang Shakti Scheme covers City Ordinary, Metro Express, Palle Velugu, Ultra Palle Velugu and Express services, across urban and rural areas. Vajra and Rapid Response are associated with Project HANUMAN, while Green Steel is associated with the AM/NS India plant.
